_about: Ours, not a design copy. The post-Trial crackdown (scenes crackdown_street and crackdown_lantern), the shut Trial Hall, the curfew order until the pick (§5: posts, notice, cordon, townsfolk indoors, Glimmerwell on the east road), Amos's and Juniper's pitches (§6), the dawn wire from Warden Ilse and her PLACEHOLDER meeting (warden_meet). D1333 (Vincent): the only change from the spec is that the pick no longer comes right at the dawn release; it waits for story.warden_met. Casts use castAt (E1); tanks walk with ms (E2); walkAll (E5). Lantern House room objects (fb_wire_set_live, the six lh_* bodies, cd_resume) live in fernbrook_rooms.json, because its maps load after every detail patch.
_placeholders: Every line here is PLACEHOLDER for June (D1208). The Commander is unnamed (D1198). 'Keeper tank' wording and the tanks' look are drafts (D1202). The Warden's lines and the dawn wire are placeholders until WARDEN_SUMMONS is written and settled (D1340-D1346). story.fen_lean steps (+1 Keep it, +1 He's hiding something, -1 He means well, 0 Hand it over) are PLACEHOLDER until Seals lore v3.1's encoding lands (D1334).

crackdown_street: A white beam slides up the road. Then the ground starts to hum.
By order of High Charity, this square is closed. Everyone home. Now.
Glimmerwell staff will pack up and leave Fernbrook tonight.
We have a permit! ...Fine. Fine! Glimmerwell is relocating.
Holder. This Hall is shut. Unvetted holders were tested here.
A Seal is the Keepers' to give, {name}. And ours to take back.
Take it, then. Watch it go dull in your hand. It knows whose it is.
The Seal sits in the Commander's glove. Its shine goes out.
Dull as a button. Keep your trinket.
The Seal hums. Then it's quiet.
Commander. Stand down. That Seal was won fair, in my Hall, in front of my roots.
Master Fen. Your Hall is closed.
{name}. Go to the Lantern House. Amos will keep you. I'll be right behind you.
Brighter by nature! Brighter... somewhere else!
Orders came from over my head, citizen. Go on in. Keep your head down.
crackdown_lantern: You'll stay in here tonight, holder. You can't leave.
Can't leave? A Lantern House is for rest, not for keeping people. On what law?
The Commander's word is the law tonight.
Then let's settle it the old way. Your Walkling and mine, right here.
Nobody battles in my town tonight.
New order. You and Master Fen stay in this house tonight. Step out before dawn, and you're both arrested.
You'd arrest a Hall Master in her own town? Listen to yourself.
A Seal says a holder can help run things here. Fernbrook doesn't need the help.
The Seal only matters if you comply.
And stay clear of Glimmerwell. Folk who help them get a name for it. Then we come asking.
Hush, all of you. The wire's on.
Block News, evening edition. We go now to the capital.
The picture flickers and cuts to the President.
Good evening, Fernbrook. For your safety, a curfew is in force tonight.
So, from tonight, Fernbrook keeps a curfew from dusk to dawn. Stay in. Keep your Walklings close.
And no new Seals will be given in Fernbrook until further notice. A Seal is a promise. We keep it carefully.
Every Seal ever earned is written down in High Charity, as it was in the Great War. It will stay that way.
A Seal is not for sale. Not to anyone. Remember that.
The Keepers keep you, and I keep the Keepers. Good night. Be kind in the streets.
Not for sale. Then who's been buying?
Maybe. He's always sounded kind. Kind isn't the same as right.
Careful who hears you say that. ...But I heard it too.
They can't take the one you've earned, {name}. Hold onto that.
Dusk to dawn. Not a minute before.
I'm writing to the Warden tonight. A Commander doesn't outrank the lantern's law.
The beds are made. Rest your team. I'll keep the lamp low.
At dawn the curfew lifts. Fen and {name} are let go.
I asked them for help with the crates. They sent boots. I won't forget it.
{name}. A wire came in at first light, for you. From Warden Ilse.
She wants you home in Hearthmoor. At the Lodge, as soon as you can walk it.
The Warden read my letter, then. Go, {name}. I have a Hall to look after, shut or not.
warden_meet: {name}. Come in, come in. I had Fen's letter, and the wire from Fernbrook.
A Commander shut a Trial Hall and kept a Hall Master indoors. That is not a small thing.
This isn't yours to carry alone. Let me ask some questions of my own first.
Fernbrook still has a question for you. Answer it at the orchard gate when you are ready.
warden_after: I'm still asking my questions. Go on back to Fernbrook when you're ready. The gate is waiting.
amos_pitch: The order came from High Charity. I don't like it either. I still keep.
What you saw isn't the Keepers. It's one Commander. Fen's gone over his head.
Walk with us and help fix it from inside. That is all I will say about it.
juniper_pitch: Hi hi! They locked a whole town indoors. We'd never. Have a bright day!
Our insurers advised a strategic relocation. The locals? They will be fine.
When you're ready to choose, warm beds and a vet are one road east. Just saying!
